_meta._note: Strict primary-source ingestion from canonical Epoch Capabilities Index CSV at https://epoch.ai/data/eci_scores.csv (172 rows; deduped to per-model best ECI). Methodology: 'A Rosetta Stone for AI Benchmarks' (arxiv 2512.00193) by Anson Ho, Jean-Stanislas Denain, David Atanasov, Samuel Albanie, Rohin Shah — IRT-style statistical model unifying 37+ AI benchmarks onto a single capability scale via stitching, putting model capabilities and benchmark difficulties on a single numerical scale without temporal/compute assumptions. Calibration anchors: GPT-5 (medium) = 150, Claude 3.5 Sonnet (Oct 2024) = 130. Confidence intervals from Rosetta Stone bootstrap. Time-versioned CSV variants (e.g., 'Gemini 2.5 Pro (Mar 2025)' vs 'Gemini 2.5 Pro (Jun 2025)') deduped to highest-ECI per canonical model_id. 16 new model registrations (o3-pro, GPT-5.4 Nano, GPT-4.1 mini/nano, o1-mini/preview, gpt-oss-120b, DeepSeek V3.2-Exp/V3.1, Grok 4 Fast / 3 mini, Qwen3/2.5-Max, Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking / Pro, Mistral Large).
